item.title: AT&T Ventures Among New Backers as Humanoid Robotics Startup Apptronik Nears $1B in Total Funding
item.description: Dallas Innovates, Every Day: Here's what's new + next in North Texas. With total capital raised approaching $1 billion and a reported post-money valuation of roughly $5.3 billion, Apptronik now ranks among the most heavily funded humanoid robotics startups in the world.…
